We downloaded all 36 alertmanager-dev builds listed in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository, 0.31.1-r0 to the current 0.35.0-r2 (there is no 0.33.1-r4), for x86_64 and aarch64, and checked each download against the index checksum. Each package holds two regular files and no symbolic links: /usr/bin/alertmanager and /usr/bin/amtool, Go programs built with GOOS=linux, CGO_ENABLED=0 and -ldflags -s -w. We read each program's function table from the Go line table, which works on these stripped binaries and finds runtime.main in every program. The google.golang.org/grpc version in the build information, the same for both programs and both architectures, is: 0.31.1-r0 to 0.31.1-r3 with 1.78.0; 0.31.1-r4 to 0.31.1-r5 with 1.79.3; 0.31.1-r6 to 0.32.1-r0 with 1.80.0; 0.32.1-r1 with 1.81.0; 0.32.1-r2 to 0.33.0-r0 with 1.81.1; 0.33.1-r0 to 0.33.1-r1 with 1.82.0; 0.33.1-r2 to 0.33.1-r3 with 1.82.1; 0.33.1-r5 with 1.83.0; 0.34.0-r0 to 0.34.0-r2 with 1.82.1; 0.34.0-r3 to 0.34.0-r4 with 1.83.1; 0.34.0-r5 with 1.83.2; 0.34.0-r6 to 0.34.1-r4 with 1.84.0 replaced by 1.83.2; 0.34.1-r5 to 0.35.0-r2 with 1.85.0 replaced by 1.83.2. The line table shows the transport functions compiled from grpc@v1.82.0 source files in 0.33.1-r1 and from grpc@v1.82.1 in 0.33.1-r2.
